# OffCode (dev-offcode.com)

> OffCode (dev-offcode.com) is an independent software brand by developer EmptyCode0x86 in Finland, not affiliated with Offcode Oy. Also known as OffCrypt, it builds privacy-focused encryption, security, automation and self-hosted communication tools. Contact: support@dev-offcode.com.

The OffCrypt apps are free, open source (GPL-3.0) and work fully offline. Screen Lock Builder Premium and Automation Tool are paid one-time lifetime licences. Web Remote Control and Tor Chat are free and self-hosted, with optional paid source-code licences for developers.

## Products

- [OffCrypt for Android](https://www.dev-offcode.com/OffCryptAndroid.html): Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) offline encryption for messages and files on Android 5.0+. AES-256 and RSA-4096, self-destructing messages.
- [OffCrypt Desktop](https://www.dev-offcode.com/OffCryptDesktop.html): Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) offline message and file encryption for Windows 10 and 11.
- [Screen Lock Builder](https://www.dev-offcode.com/ScreenLockBuilder.html): Free builder for custom Windows screen lockers (Windows 7, 8, 10, 11) without writing code.
- [Screen Lock Builder Premium](https://www.dev-offcode.com/ScreenLockBuilderPremium.html): Paid lifetime edition that adds folder, program and website locking, saved configs and themes. Uses a hardware ID only for licence activation.
- [Automation Tool](https://www.dev-offcode.com/AutomationTool.html): Paid lifetime Windows 10/11 automation with OCR, UI Automation, macro recording and an AI Script Builder (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq or local Ollama).
- [Web Remote Control](https://www.dev-offcode.com/RemoteControl.html): Free, self-hosted, browser-based remote control for Windows: live screen, file transfer, task manager and remote terminal.
- [Tor Chat](https://www.dev-offcode.com/TorChatPage.html): Free, self-hosted end-to-end encrypted chat over a Tor Hidden Service. The host runs on Windows, macOS, Ubuntu Desktop or Docker; guests join with Tor Browser.

## Community and support

- [Community](https://www.dev-offcode.com/Community.html): Optional Discord for support and coding discussion. GDPR and licence questions go to support@dev-offcode.com.
